_comment: Hierarchical MILP AllGather on rail_spine_leaf. 32 hosts x 8 GPUs, 8 rail leaves, 4 spines -> 44-node coarse graph. Every GPU owns one rail uplink, so 'holder' keeps all 8 rails usable (8 MILP chunks per host = the instance that previously timed out after 2h with no incumbent at fine chunking); 'cell' is 1 chunk per host (previously ~26 min optimal) but rides ONE rail per host. milp_chunking='cell': one MILP chunk = one host's chunks for one destination-cell set. Smallest model; voids multipath on hosts with more than one uplink -- the tractability fallback. SLOWEST_LINK keeps every coarse link at >= 1 chunk/epoch (occupancy 1: no multi-epoch legs, no cut-through optimism). switch_copy is forced off at MILP levels anyway (copy happens at hosts). Outputs: Schedules/<prefix>_flat.json (+ _coarse/_identities/_intra side outputs). See teccl/hierarchy/milp_design.md.
